storage.value:
Object description

Product Contract is the legal agreement between the energy supplier and a customer for the supply of electricity or energy products. It defines the terms, pricing, and conditions for delivering energy to the customer's points of delivery.

Key business elements:

  • Links a customer to specific energy products and pricing

  • Associates with one or more Points of Delivery (PODs) where energy is supplied

  • Defines contract lifecycle dates: signing, activation, entry into force, term end, termination

  • Supports contract statuses: draft, ready, signed, active, terminated, etc.

  • Serves as the basis for billing runs and invoice generation

  • Can be term-based or perpetual

  • Can have multiple versions

Sub-page

Phase 1

Phase 2

Product contract create

  1. There is no sub-status “In process” and there is no possibility to save contract without filling mandatory fields

  2. There is no possibility to add pods which are connected to customer through POD object

  3. There is no preferences field in product, therefore there is no check on matching product/service and customer based on preferences

  4. There is no possibility to create product contract with manually entered number

  5. There is no field “Additional information”

  1. There is new sub-status “In process” which lets users save contract without filling any mandatory fields

  2. There is new button “Get customer PODs” which lets users add pods which are connected to customer through POD object

  3. There is a preferences field in product, so in product contract there is a check if product is compatible with customer

  4. User with specific permission can create product contract with manually entered number

  5. There is a field “Additional information”
